C1797.title: Employee of Zuoyebang Ordered to Pay Punitive Damages for Disclosing Key Business Data to Third Parties
C1797.summary: An employee of Zuoyebang disclosed proprietary data during one-on-one phone interviews with a client of an external company and permitted the recipient to use the information. The court found that this conduct breached confidentiality obligations, constituted disclosure and unauthorized use of trade secrets, and infringed upon Zuoyebang's business secrets.
